name: dotoriwiki
description: Save memos to the personal LLM wiki from any machine on the tailnet: the /memo skill plus the gateway's MCP server.

url.title: Gateway URL
url.description: The gateway on the tailnet, without /mcp, such as http://my-mac.tail-1234.ts.net:8787.

token.title: Gateway token
token.description: GATEWAY_TOKEN. On the gateway machine: npm run pair -- --show-token
